versions.changelog: Trip.com hotel links: tripcom_url in search-hotels and in thin search-tours results

Rules from 15-destination live tests: kids_ages, exact stars, center distance, unsupported conditions, atoll-wide hotel comparison, 31-day window, one-way combo for flights, local departure time, activity city fallback.

Universal search rules: every constraint as a parameter (first line, beach distance, party/stay budget, exact resorts), one search per OR value, named-hotel comparison with verification, budget re-check after tour details, per-adult flight prices, activity query.
Server error text reaches the model; date, meal and nights rules; cheapest-tours command; long round trips as two legs; rate_limited category; UTF-8-safe output.
Добавлен поиск поездов Tutu.ru: направления на русском языке, дата поездки, сортировка, ориентировочные цены и безопасные ссылки для проверки наличия мест.
Improved discovery for Russian travel-planning requests while keeping live search as the skill scope.
Tripster + Sputnik8, activity filters and sorting, normalized price units, silent provider failover
Added explicit metadata.permissions for single-endpoint HTTPS egress and bundled CLI execution; added privacy and unknown-retention notice to usage. Runtime CLI contract unchanged.

Narrowed activation to explicit live travel search; documented Russian-language catalog without forcing reply language; declared Python/network/data compatibility; normalized frontmatter to official Agent Skills YAML. Runtime CLI contract unchanged.

Breaking v2: lightweight Python 3.8+ CLI over production travel MCP; seven commands; live schemas via describe; raw API client and provider docs removed; strict Streamable HTTP lifecycle, deadlines, size limits, redirects, and safe errors.
Исправлены Travelata-маршруты и таймаут актуализации; добавлена актуальная документация MCP.
Level.Travel переведён на живой асинхронный поиск: enqueue -> get_grouped_hotels, дети, любые даты и длительности, hotel-only. Travelata + Level.Travel параллельно на каждый туровый запрос.
Simplify tour and flight result formatting with calmer compact shortlists and section-based presentation.
Improve exact-area tour handling and shortlist presentation; avoid silent geographic broadening and present cleaner compact results.
Clarify skill description and README with explicit search providers: Aviasales, Travelata + Level.Travel, and Sputnik8.
Level.Travel parallel source (cached snapshot, 2 adults, 7-15 nights)
Fix empty tours for far destinations: wait 3-5s based on destination, soft poll via repeated GET /tours before relaxing filters
Migrate Travelata to Partners API: live search, multiple tours per date, search by specific hotel, kids ages 2-17 with kidsAges[], 4+ adults supported
Fix display name
Fix Egypt country ID (34→29), UAE (69→68). Remove hardcoded Travelata IDs — bot resolves dynamically via directory endpoints. Sanitize error responses.
Add keywords: aviasales, travelata, sputnik8, tripster, flights, tours, excursions, travel, russia, turkey, egypt, booking
Initial release: flights (Aviasales), tours (Travelata), excursions (Sputnik8)
